clips.title: The story
paras: A crate of raw metal stored at the human smithy in Hillsbrad Fields. It serves as vital stock for local armament production, making it a priority target for Forsaken forces seeking to cut off the supply lines arming the Hillsbrad townsfolk.

In the ongoing struggle across the Hillsbrad Foothills, the human peasantry has mounted surprisingly stiff resistance against Tarren Mill. Much of this fighting capability stems directly from the smithy at the southwestern edge of the Hillsbrad Fields, where Blacksmith Verringtan and his apprentices work round the clock churning out weapons and armor from heavy shipments of iron. To break the farmers' resolve, Forsaken commanders ordered the forge extinguished, its smiths eliminated, and its stockpiled metal seized for the Horde war effort.
